---
title: Broken Sample
description: A page whose second sample calls a method the builder does not have.
---

A lede that stands on its own, because an agent reads it first.

## Overview

The first sample compiles.

```ts
import { text } from "plumix/fields";

export const subtitle = text("subtitle").label("Subtitle");
```

## Quickstart

The second does not: `maxLen` is not a method on the builder.

```ts
import { text } from "plumix/fields";

export const summary = text("summary").maxLen(120);
```
